text.description_html:
Carry Bar for Stop Mounted Coordinator, Don-Jo 2060

Don-Jo's 2060 carry bar is used on a pair of doors where the inactive door can be opened before the active door. It is mounted on the inactive door and is not to be used in conjunction with automatic or self-latching flush bolts. Includes 3 ea. #10-32 x 1" machine screws and 3 ea. #10-32 x 1-9/16" sex nuts.

*Sold Individually
